summary: Layer site-local authentication return continuity on top of the approved v1.19.0 EKODI-owned virtualization sovereignty constitution.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly instructed EKODI on 2026-09-23 to make site-local post-login return behavior a mandatory rule, including restoring workspace/service admin users to the exact admin section and allowing My EKODI only for apex/My-specific login flows.
adds: exact trusted return_to is the first post-login destination
site-local My/authenticated home or canonical site entry is fallback only
My EKODI generic fallback is forbidden
workspace/service admin child path is preserved after login
misrouted handoff tokens arriving at My EKODI redirect before token consumption
preserves: v1.19.0 EKODI-owned virtualization sovereignty and native execution rules
rollback: Revert only the v1.20.0 authentication-return-continuity policy, service-workspace authenticationReturnPolicy, and matching auth/client/My routing changes while preserving the approved v1.19.0 EKODI-owned virtualization sovereignty constitution and all user identities, memberships, sessions and workspace data.
